from.place: Proof paragraph 1: scalar-compatible finite-stage exchange maps; the finite-to-Qbar condensed coefficient interface needed by the archived target

title: Proper pushforward and exchange compatibility for condensed finite-to-Qbar coefficient extension
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, write $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and order its finite intermediate extensions $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ by inclusion [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Use the condensed rings $\underline E(S)=C(S,E)$ on profinite sets and the coefficient pullback $p_T^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Define $\underline\Omega(S)$ to be the subring of $C(S,\Omega)$ consisting of continuous functions whose values lie in one finite intermediate extension, with restrictions by precomposition. Thus $\underline\Omega$ is the archived $\mathrm{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$, not the full continuous-function sheaf. Put $E_T^c=p_T^*\underline E$ and $\Omega_T^c=p_T^*\underline\Omega$. Write $\mathcal C_E^c(T)$ for the bounded constructible module-object category of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and define $\mathcal C_\Omega^c(T)$ by the identical construction with coefficient ring $\Omega_T^c$: a full subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Omega_T^c})$, with bounded cohomology, each cohomology sheaf stratified pro-etale locally finitely presented. No derived completeness condition is imposed. Let $T_{E,F}^T=F_T^c\otimes^L_{E_T^c}-$ and $T_{E,\Omega}^T=\Omega_T^c\otimes^L_{E_T^c}-$ denote derived extension of scalars along the coefficient inclusions. Let $k$ be a field of prime positive characteristic different from $\ell$, and let $X,Y,X',Y'$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$ be $k$-morphisms forming a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f$ proper. For $A=E,\Omega$ write $l_{h,A}=Lh_A^*$ and $r_{h,A}=Rh_{A,*}$ for the condensed-module derived operations and $B_A:l_{g,A}r_{f,A}\Rightarrow r_{f',A}l_{g',A}$ for the specified unit-square-counit exchange of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], using $A_T^c$ as coefficients. For each finite $E$, the canonical derived coefficient-change comparisons restrict to the bounded constructible categories. They give pullback isomorphisms $T_{E,\Omega}^T l_{h,E}\cong l_{h,\Omega}T_{E,\Omega}^U$ for each edge $h:T\to U$, and the canonical pushforward comparison $T_{E,\Omega}^U r_{h,E}\to r_{h,\Omega}T_{E,\Omega}^T$ is an isomorphism on bounded constructible objects for $h=f,f'$. For $K\in\mathcal C_E^c(X)$, define $S_K$ by first using the pullback comparison for $g$ and then $l_{g,\Omega}$ of the pushforward comparison for $f$, and define $U_K$ by first using the pushforward comparison for $f'$ and then $r_{f',\Omega}$ of the pullback comparison for $g'$. Their types are
$$S_K:T_{E,\Omega}^{Y'}l_{g,E}r_{f,E}K\xrightarrow{\sim}l_{g,\Omega}r_{f,\Omega}T_{E,\Omega}^{X}K,$$
$$U_K:T_{E,\Omega}^{Y'}r_{f',E}l_{g',E}K\xrightarrow{\sim}r_{f',\Omega}l_{g',\Omega}T_{E,\Omega}^{X}K.$$
They satisfy the equality of specified arrows
$$B_\Omega(T_{E,\Omega}^{X}K)\circ S_K=U_K\circ T_{E,\Omega}^{Y'}(B_E(K)).$$
No invertibility of $B_E$ or $B_\Omega$ is asserted.
